description: This file declares a class QLinearOnednn with static methods for performing quantized linear tensor operations, including pointwise and binary ops, using oneDNN acceleration within the at::native namespace. It also declares a function for weight tensor packing.

classes.name: QLinearOnednn
classes.description: A final class providing static methods for quantized linear tensor computations optimized with oneDNN.

methods.name: run_pointwise_tensor
methods.description: Performs a pointwise quantized tensor operation, likely a linear or activation layer, using scale and zero-point parameters for quantization, with optional post-processing.

methods.name: run_pointwise_binary_tensor
methods.description: Performs a binary pointwise quantized tensor operation with an additional tensor, supporting post-ops and various quantization parameters.

methods.name: _weight_int4pack_mm_cpu_tensor
methods.description: Function for packing weight tensors in int4 format for optimized CPU matrix multiplication.
